channel.title: Parallax
channel.description: Same event, different vantage points. Geopolitical news compared across Western, Eastern, Middle Eastern and Russian outlets.

item.title: United States and Iran exchange strikes on naval vessels and oil tankers in escalating conflict.
item.description: On September 5, 2026, the United States and Iran engaged in a series of retaliatory strikes involving American warships and three Iranian oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. Western outlets frame the U.S. actions as a defensive measure against a "ghost fleet" used to bypass international sanctions. Conversely, Middle Eastern and Russian sources emphasize Iranian efforts to defend regional sovereignty and maritime security against foreign interference in local waterways.
